title: Really like this ! Definitely easier to do!
text: Really like this ! Definitely easier to do!. I really liked this. It was very easy to use my only concern would be it definitely is a little tricky to get together on your first try, definitely read the instructions first and also the tube part keeps on coming apart I mean I know it's normal and you just stick it back together but it's really bothersome when cleaning, etc... I just wish it stayed in place easily and also the top parts that close the tube are hard to work with. The extra slicer is really good addition and works great!
